schema.sharedShape: Todas las claves siguientes tienen la misma forma:

glossary.$comment-host: host is rendered three ways, by sense, and none of them is a slip: "host de agente" keeps the English word in the agent-host compound, "anfitrión" is the federation host, and "plataforma de alojamiento" is a hosting provider. Do not unify them.
glossary.$comment-change-record: "change record" is "historial del cambio", the one record compound that leaves the "registro" family, so that it cannot be read as "registro de cambios" (changelog).
glossary.$comment-conformance-levels: The four conformance level identifiers (core, indexed, governed, federated) stay English and backticked wherever they name a level; only the surrounding noun translates, so "governed (content)" is the adjective "gobernado" and never a level name.
glossary.$comment-governance: "gobernanza" over "gobierno": the Spanish Kubernetes glossary uses "gobernanza" for exactly this open-source sense, while "gobierno" reads as government. A reasoned choice, not an oversight.
glossary.$comment-review-gate: The English "gate" family is translated by meaning, one sense at a time, and no longer as a single "puerta" calque. A review gate is the repository's review-and-approval process ("proceso de revisión y aprobación"); a human gate is human approval ("aprobación humana"); a blocking gate is a check whose failure stops the work ("comprobación cuyo fallo impide continuar", and "no gated" is "que no impiden continuar"); a conformance gate is the check that determines conformance ("comprobación que determine la conformidad"); a commercial gate is a commercial requirement, stated in the negative as "sin requisitos comerciales"; the automated gates a hook or a pipeline runs are "comprobaciones", and blocking enforcement is "controles obligatorios"; the proven-twice and capture gates are criteria, kept as "regla de probado dos veces" and "regla de captura".
glossary.$comment-pin: "pin" carries two senses in this set and they take different Spanish. Version pinning is "fijación" and "fijado", never GitHub's Spanish "anclado", which names a different thing (a repository pinned to a profile) and would collide. Navigation pinning, where a page sits at the top of the sidebar, is the plain "fijar" and "página fijada": it is placement, not an immutable version, so the version wording is not forced onto it.
glossary.assist work: realizar trabajo o colaborar en él
glossary.array: array (masculino: «el array»); «arreglo» aceptable al citar fuentes que lo usan
glossary.checkout currency: actualidad de la copia de trabajo
glossary.equal access, not equal authority: el acceso es igual, la autoridad no
glossary.fallback: mecanismo de reserva o alternativa (sustantivo); recurrir a (verbo)
glossary.hand off (agent workflow): traspasar la tarea o el control
glossary.owner: responsable (de un documento, una decisión o una capa de contexto); propietario (de un repositorio, una organización o un proyecto)
glossary.prune: podar (contenido de la capa de contexto); recortar (referencias u objetos que dejan de estar referenciados, como en git)
glossary.redacted (restricted content removed): expurgado del contenido restringido; nunca «redactado», que significa «escrito»
glossary.review gate: revisión y aprobación obligatorias; en las páginas, «proceso de revisión y aprobación»
glossary.RFC 2119 keywords (MUST, SHOULD, MAY, …): se mantienen en inglés y en negrita, como en el original
glossary.scripted: generado por script; una ejecución automatizada
